name: reward-bench-cleaned-preview
description: A cleaned preview of Reward Bench data for evaluating reward models and preference prediction. The dataset contains human (and/or annotator) preference labels or rankings over model outputs intended for training/evaluating reward models and alignment procedures.
evaluation_method: human_eval (agreement / accuracy at predicting human preferences)
general_score_metric: accuracy (preference prediction / agreement with human labels)
reputation: Preview dataset hosted on Hugging Face used by researchers working on reward modeling and RLHF; moderate but growing visibility in the alignment community.
